answer: The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 22 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. A farm of 598 identities would post 3309 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
